criterion.standard: counts it worthwhile only if the record he leaves behind is more certain than the one he inherited
criterion.wasted_life: a disputed record passed to the next clerk with a shrug instead of settled while it was still his to settle
criterion.trusts: the oldest surviving copy of a record, whatever it actually says
criterion.distrusts: whichever version of a succession gets repeated most confidently around the office

routines.routine_actions: processes permits and disputes at the municipal desk, still digging through the oldest storage ledgers on his own time
walks the Dome Market once a week collecting stall fees and hearing complaints firsthand

arc.premise: Terniko wants to settle, once and for all in the municipal record, whether the old citadel succession - prince Doran's father, and after him the two princes, Forlan and Forlias - actually passed cleanly, or whether the disputed half-record everyone in the office quietly argues about is closer to the truth. He's pulled the oldest ledger up from storage and means to have a real answer entered before the record's next official review, not another shrug passed on to whoever takes the desk after him.
